output.rule: When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.
output.explanation_template: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.

examples.explanation: 他喝了茶 → 喝了茶: 他 is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.
神农回他的家 → 神农回家: 他的 is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.
而是她望子成龙 → 而是望子成龙: in 不是……而是……, the subject is not repeated after 而是.
不是孟子喜欢这个城市，而是他喜欢这个城市的人 → 孟子不是喜欢这个城市，而是喜欢这个城市的人: put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.
请他们给他建议怎么减轻他的家庭的负担 → 请他们给他建议怎么减轻家庭的负担: there are too many 他; 他的 is already clear, so delete it.

output.not_an_error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.
